result.quote: There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath.
result.reason: The key is a reasonable paraphrase, but it is not unique. Before seeing the king’s son, the commanders were also brought into the house of the LORD. Moreover, the passage describes Jehoiada as making the covenant and putting them under oath, rather than directly saying what the commanders “must do.” The question also needs “the” before “king’s son” and should specify the intended immediately preceding actions.
